settings.heading: Comfort is evolving.
settings.text: CLIMORA is a South African cooling technology brand. We bring together innovative, practical products that help you stay comfortable when the temperature rises.

settings.heading: Staying cool should be easier.
settings.text:
At CLIMORA, we believe staying comfortable should be easier, smarter and more accessible. We bring together innovative cooling solutions designed to help you navigate warmer days and enjoy more comfortable nights.

We started with three essentials — a solar-rechargeable fan, a cooling pillowcase and a cooling mattress topper — each chosen for how it fits into everyday South African life.
